content.title: Guardians vs. Dodgers: Prediction, Lineups, How to Watch (3/30)
content.text: The Cleveland Guardians (2–2) visit the defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers (3–0) tonight at Dodger Stadium. The Dodgers enter with a perfect 3–0 start to the season. They opened the year with an 8–2 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks before edging them by a run in each of the next two games to complete the sweep. L.A. took Saturday’s matchup 3–2, with Tyler Glasnow allowing just two runs on four hits over six innings before turning it over to the bullpen. Dodgers relievers have yet to allow a run this season — one of only three teams to maintain that mark through the first three games. Will Smith delivered the decisive blow in that game, hitting his second home run of the season in the bottom of the eighth to score Mookie Betts and give Los Angeles the lead for good. The Guardians, meanwhile, arrive in Los Angeles after splitting a four-game series with the Seattle Mariners, capped by an 8–0 loss on Sunday. Seattle starter Emerson Hancock held Cleveland hitless through six innings before being lifted. Still, there are positives for Cleveland — most notably rookie Chase DeLauter, who homered in each of his first three games and enters tonight with four total dingers. Parker Messick gets the start for Cleveland, looking to build on the momentum from a strong MLB debut last August. He went 3–1 with a 2.72 ERA over seven starts in 2025. Roki Sasaki makes his 2026 debut for the Dodgers after an injury-limited rookie season in which he struggled as a starter but thrived in relief — especially in the postseason, where he posted a 0.84 ERA over nine appearances with three saves. He returns to the rotation — for now — but his spring performance raises questions. Sasaki posted a 15.58 ERA over four starts, issuing 15 walks in just 8.2 innings. Expect Cleveland to put pressure on Sasaki early before the Dodgers’ bullpen takes over. How quickly Los Angeles turns to its relievers could limit the damage, but the Guardians have the edge. Final Score Prediction: Cleveland Guardians 7, Los Angeles Dodgers 4 Starting Lineups Cleveland Guardians Steven Kwan — LF Chase DeLauter — DH José Ramírez — 3B Kyle Manzardo — 1B Daniel Schneemann — CF Brayan Rocchio — 2B Gabriel Arias — SS Austin Hedges — C Angel Martínez — RF Starting Pitcher: Parker Messick Los Angeles Dodgers Shohei Ohtani — DH Kyle Tucker — RF Mookie Betts — SS Teoscar Hernández — LF Freddie Freeman — 1B Andy Pages — CF Max Muncy — 3B Miguel Rojas — 2B Dalton Rushing — C Starting Pitcher: Roki Sasaki How to Watch Guardians vs. Dodgers First pitch is scheduled for 10:10 PM Eastern / 7:10 PM Pacific at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.
